fix-diff.txt:
--- scripts/media/fixtures/broken-pr-review.nika.yaml	2026-08-19 03:11:28
+++ scripts/media/fixtures/fixed-pr-review.nika.yaml	2026-08-19 03:11:28
@@ -1,8 +1,7 @@
 # SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
-# media fixture · deliberately BROKEN — the static-check-fix demo "before".
-# Two real defects: a task reads another task's output straight from its
-# verb body (outside the `with:` boundary), and a typo'd task reference in
-# the `with:` binding that feeds the `when:` gate.
+# media fixture · the static-check-fix demo "after" — same workflow, fixed:
+# the diff crosses the `with:` boundary, fixed typo, cost ceiling, strict
+# schema, permits.
 nika: pr-risk-review
 model: ollama/llama3.1
 
@@ -13,19 +12,23 @@
       capture: structured
 
   assess:
+    with:
+      diff: ${{ tasks.diff.output.stdout }}
     infer:
       prompt: |
         Risk-assess this diff. Be terse.
-        ${{ tasks.diff.output.stdout }}
+        ${{ with.diff }}
+      max_tokens: 400
       schema:
         type: object
         required: [risk]
+        additionalProperties: false
         properties:
           risk: { type: string, enum: [low, medium, high] }
 
   comment:
     with:
-      risk: ${{ tasks.asses.output.risk }}
+      risk: ${{ tasks.assess.output.risk }}
       assessment: ${{ tasks.assess.output }}
     when: "${{ with.risk == 'high' }}"
     invoke:
@@ -33,3 +36,9 @@
       args:
         path: "review.md"
         content: "${{ with.assessment }}"
+
+permits:
+  fs:
+    write: ["review.md"]
+  exec: ["git"]
+  tools: ["nika:write"]

-# then one task quietly reaches beyond it. `nika check` catches the escape
-# statically and prints the machine-applicable fix. Deliberately escaping.
+# The permits-audit asset · ACT 3 — the two-line fix: the host joins the
+# declared boundary, max_tokens turns the cost floor into a HARD ceiling.

-  net: { http: ["api.github.com"] }   # the declared boundary — GitHub only
+  net: { http: ["api.github.com", "nika.sh"] }   # the boundary, widened on purpose
   fs: { write: ["./out/**"] }
   tools: ["nika:fetch", "nika:write"]
